sentences.narration: Overthinking feels like problem solving, but sometimes it is a loop wearing a lab coat.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: Overthinking feels like problem solving, but sometimes it is a loop wearing a lab coat.

sentences.narration: You replay the conversation, inspect one sentence and search for the hidden meaning.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: You replay the conversation, inspect one sentence and search for the hidden meaning.

sentences.narration: For a moment, the extra analysis feels useful.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: For a moment, the extra analysis feels useful.

sentences.narration: Then the same question returns with a slightly different shape.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: Then the same question returns with a slightly different shape.

sentences.narration: What if I sounded foolish?
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: What if I sounded foolish?

sentences.narration: What if they noticed?
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: What if they noticed?

sentences.narration: What if I choose wrong?
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: What if I choose wrong?

sentences.narration: The loop promises certainty, but it keeps moving the finish line.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: The loop promises certainty, but it keeps moving the finish line.

sentences.narration: Useful thinking changes what you can do next.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: Useful thinking changes what you can do next.

sentences.narration: It gathers information, compares options and reaches a decision.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: It gathers information, compares options and reaches a decision.

sentences.narration: Overthinking often changes your emotional state more than your available information.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: Overthinking often changes your emotional state more than your available information.

sentences.narration: The first mechanism is attention capture.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: The first mechanism is attention capture.

sentences.narration: A thought with threat or social importance pulls the spotlight back.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: A thought with threat or social importance pulls the spotlight back.

sentences.narration: The mind treats the unresolved question as unfinished business.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: The mind treats the unresolved question as unfinished business.

sentences.narration: Each return feels urgent because the brain is still waiting for closure.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: Each return feels urgent because the brain is still waiting for closure.

sentences.narration: But urgency is not proof that another review will help.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: But urgency is not proof that another review will help.

sentences.narration: The second mechanism is uncertainty.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: The second mechanism is uncertainty.

sentences.narration: When an outcome cannot be guaranteed, imagination generates more possibilities.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: When an outcome cannot be guaranteed, imagination generates more possibilities.

sentences.narration: Possibilities multiply faster than evidence.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: Possibilities multiply faster than evidence.

sentences.narration: Soon you are evaluating scenarios that have no new data behind them.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: Soon you are evaluating scenarios that have no new data behind them.

sentences.narration: The third mechanism is self-focused attention.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: The third mechanism is self-focused attention.

sentences.narration: You stop examining the event and start examining yourself inside the event.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: You stop examining the event and start examining yourself inside the event.

sentences.narration: How did I look?
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: How did I look?

sentences.narration: What did my face reveal?
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: What did my face reveal?

sentences.narration: What did their pause mean?
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: What did their pause mean?

sentences.narration: The scene becomes a mirror with no exit.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: The scene becomes a mirror with no exit.

sentences.narration: This is why the loop can feel productive.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: This is why the loop can feel productive.

sentences.narration: Every lap contains a new detail, even when the conclusion never changes.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: Every lap contains a new detail, even when the conclusion never changes.

sentences.narration: A new detail is not always new information.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: A new detail is not always new information.

sentences.narration: Sometimes it is the same uncertainty wearing a different costume.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: Sometimes it is the same uncertainty wearing a different costume.

sentences.narration: Emotion then strengthens the loop.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: Emotion then strengthens the loop.

sentences.narration: An anxious interpretation creates discomfort.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: An anxious interpretation creates discomfort.

sentences.narration: Discomfort makes the question feel more important.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: Discomfort makes the question feel more important.

sentences.narration: Importance pulls attention back to the interpretation.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: Importance pulls attention back to the interpretation.

sentences.narration: The loop feeds itself without needing a new fact.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: The loop feeds itself without needing a new fact.

sentences.narration: That does not mean reflection is always harmful.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: That does not mean reflection is always harmful.

sentences.narration: You can replay an event to learn, repair or choose a better action.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: You can replay an event to learn, repair or choose a better action.

sentences.narration: The difference is whether the review produces a usable update.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: The difference is whether the review produces a usable update.

sentences.narration: What would I do differently next time?
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: What would I do differently next time?

sentences.narration: What evidence would change my belief?
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: What evidence would change my belief?

sentences.narration: What conversation or experiment could resolve this?
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: What conversation or experiment could resolve this?

sentences.narration: Those questions point outward toward information and action.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: Those questions point outward toward information and action.

sentences.narration: The loop points inward toward perfect certainty.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: The loop points inward toward perfect certainty.

sentences.narration: Perfect certainty is a target the world rarely provides.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: Perfect certainty is a target the world rarely provides.

sentences.narration: So the mind keeps generating one more angle.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: So the mind keeps generating one more angle.

sentences.narration: One more angle can become one more hour.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: One more angle can become one more hour.

sentences.narration: A practical exit is not to force the thought away.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: A practical exit is not to force the thought away.

sentences.narration: It is to identify the missing information or name the decision already available.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: It is to identify the missing information or name the decision already available.

sentences.narration: If no new information would change your action, more analysis may be repetition.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: If no new information would change your action, more analysis may be repetition.

sentences.narration: If new information would change your action, define how you will get it.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: If new information would change your action, define how you will get it.

sentences.narration: Thinking becomes useful again when it has an exit condition.
sentences.visual_brief: distinct visual for: Thinking becomes useful again when it has an exit condition.

sentences.narration: What information would change your next action?
